redacted_summary: Refund requested on day 16 after delivery for an unused, unopened item; outside the 14-day refund window.
resolution: Supervisor approved a one-off exception; refund issued to the original payment method.

redacted_summary: Refund of about EGP 4,500 for a returned coat; above the automatic refund limit.
resolution: Reviewer confirmed the return was received and inspected at the warehouse, then approved the full refund.

redacted_summary: Customer asked to change the delivery address after the order had already shipped.
resolution: Address could not be changed. Customer refused the parcel at the door and placed a new order with the new address.

redacted_summary: Cancellation requested after shipping while the courier was already on the way.
resolution: Customer care cancelled with the courier before the delivery attempt; prepaid amount refunded minus the shipping fee.

redacted_summary: Order arrived 5 business days after the estimated date and the late-delivery voucher had not been issued.
resolution: Agent confirmed the dates and issued the standard EGP 100 voucher for the next order.

resolution: تم عرض استرجاع المبلغ بدل الاستبدال ووافق العميل، وتم فتح طلب استرجاع عادي.

redacted_summary: Return requested for an item bought in the final clearance sale marked no returns or exchanges.
resolution: Return declined because clearance items are final sale; policy explained and case closed.
